clips.title: Rieder：不提供前瞻指引是好事 ETF IQ

subtitles.en: So we have a lot of ETF-related things to get into. Bank, of course, just had a big birthday, but given the size of the moves that we're seeing in the market right now, let's start broad.
subtitles.zh: 我们有很多ETF相关话题要聊。银行刚过生日，但鉴于市场波动，我们先从宏观说起。

subtitles.en: The S&P 500, higher by nearly 2%, the Nasdaq 100, higher by more than 3% on the heels of that peace agreement announcement, then you take a look at the bond market, still a big move.
subtitles.zh: 标普500涨近2%，纳斯达克100涨超3%，受和平协议消息推动。再看债市，波动也很大。

subtitles.en: You did see yields drop across the curve coming back a little bit though. When you put it all together, you take a look at the different Nasdaq classes and you add oil in there. I mean, what's your initial
subtitles.zh: 收益率曲线全线回落。综合来看，不同纳斯达克板块和油价，你的初步解读是什么？

subtitles.en: read on this knee jerk? So I'd say obviously the peace agreement, and as you said, we'll say how durable it is. My senses are moving in a direction that ultimately will be quite positive. So
subtitles.zh: 和平协议是利好，但要看持久性。我感觉方向最终会非常积极。

subtitles.en: the thing that's amazing to me, and by the way, it played out around the SpaceX transaction, there is so much cash that's sitting on the sideline. So we get to be a number, depending on how you
subtitles.zh: 令人惊讶的是，场外有大量现金，就像SpaceX交易时那样。

subtitles.en: measure eight or nine trillion of money market funds, 19 trillion of deposits. And you know, what happened? You go back a week ago and you think about this big SpaceX deal. People have to
subtitles.zh: 货币基金有8-9万亿，存款19万亿。一周前SpaceX大交易，市场参与者需要调整组合。

subtitles.en: find room in terms of portfolios, et cetera. So you create a little bit of that. And then once that has happened, all of a sudden it unlocks this cash, particularly when you get a good piece of news
subtitles.zh: 一旦释放，现金被激活，尤其好消息传来，人们涌入市场，涨势会很猛。

subtitles.en: and people say, gosh, I can get into the pool. And it's pretty explosive when you see it happen.
subtitles.zh: 当人们说可以入场了，涨势会非常爆炸性。

subtitles.en: Obviously the move, you know, after we've had a good run, the equity market has been pretty impressive today.
subtitles.zh: 显然，在经历一轮上涨后，今天权益市场表现相当亮眼。
